propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed that reads persisted REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and computes detection and blocking-FP metrics incrementally without outcome-corpus git-walks or per-criterion registration.
The recorder appends one firing row per (review-round, finding) to an append-only, prune-immune ledger keyed by (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id), auto-including every criterion id observed.

The --report mode computes, per criterion over a trailing window, detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later de-escalated/dropped and never remediated), with null denominators when counts are zero.

The committed metrics artifact criterion_effectiveness.json demonstrates the recorder works over the existing corpus with at least 30 criteria auto-included, multiple non-null detection_proxy and blocking_fp_proxy rates.
The recorder is deterministic, makes zero LLM calls, and complements R7's outcome-corpus metric via sidecar-only signal distinct from force-close/reopen post-hoc measurement.

The standing invocation pattern (--record incremental append, then --report) follows R7 precedent and is documented in plan-review-gate.md as the advisory-to-blocking promotion-gate protocol for R1/R3/R4 criteria.
